{{nihongo|'''Hitsujisaki Shrine (Minato, Ishinomaki)'''|零羊崎神社 (石巻市湊)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Mutsu Province]].
